*** GILT: CNBC IS SHOWING A SUNDAY-NIGHT QUOTE AND IT IS REJECTED ***
CNBC returned UK10Y-GB at 5.351, a change of -0.0255, stamped 2026-10-18T22:01 UTC — i.e. 23:01 on a
Sunday night, when the cash gilt market is definitively shut. Trading Economics still returns 5.38
"as of Oct/16", which is Friday.
PUBLISHED: 5.38, +0.00 — Friday's close, as published this morning.
The reasoning is the same one used all week in a harder form: the cash gilt market shuts at 17:00 on a
working day, so a weekday 18:00 read is not a close; on a Sunday night there is no cash market at all,
so a 5.35 print cannot be a cash gilt yield. It is most likely futures-derived or a carried artefact.
Checking it was worthwhile — taking it at face value would have published a 3bp move that did not happen.

CNBC @LCO.1 108.82, -0.95%, against a correct previous settle of 109.86 and stamped 23:48 BST tonight.
That is internally consistent and is published as given — the provider's own change figure, no hand
computation needed, unlike this morning.
Trading Economics returns 101.03 with a change of +3.51% "as of Oct/18". The level is about eight
dollars below CNBC, the fourth consecutive day its Brent page has done this, and the change it reports
is still FRIDAY's move rather than tonight's. It is not used for Brent in any respect tonight.

*** GOLD: REOPENED, AND THE TWO PROVIDERS AGREE TO WITHIN 13 CENTS ***
CNBC 4,175.73 against Trading Economics 4,175.86, both stamped today. Unambiguous, and a welcome
contrast to this morning when gold's change had to be computed by hand because the endpoint's
previous-close field equalled its last price. Published +0.26% against Friday's 4,165.01 close.

*** UST: A PROVIDER INCONSISTENCY WORTH RECORDING, WITH NO EFFECT ON THE PUBLISHED FIGURE ***
CNBC now gives 5.081 against a previous close of 5.098. This morning the same endpoint gave 5.081
against 5.087. The previous-close field has drifted by about a basis point over the weekend with
nothing having traded. Trading Economics gives 5.09 "as of Oct/16", having given 5.08 this morning.
PUBLISHED: 5.08, -0.01 — unchanged from this morning, because the market has been shut throughout and
our own published series is the stable reference when a provider's own field moves without a trade.
